item.title: CaSSECS
item.description: Project’s summary CaSSECS 1 is a research and development project supporting innovation for the resilience of pastoral and agropastoral farming systems in the Sahelian countries of the CILSS. It is implemented through a consortium of eighteen partners (a lead applicant ISRA, nine co-applicants, and eight associates). Project Objectives The overall objective of the project is to improve the assessment of the carbon balance of (agro)pastoral farming systems to better quantify their impacts on climate change and develop livestock policies adapted to the Sahel.

item.title: INSA
item.description: Project’s summary The Integrated Nitrogen Studies in Africa (INSA)1 project seeks to unpack and analyze the different aspects of the nitrogen budget in Africa, bringing expertise from different fields in the environmental and social sciences through a network of scientists from Europe and Africa. Learn more about INSA on the project website . ↩︎
